2607.29064.title: Benchmarking Frontier Large Language Models Against Official Crash Database Coding Using Police Crash Narratives
2607.29064.paper_summary: Police crash narratives contain information that may supplement structured crash databases, but manual review is labor-intensive and it remains unclear how well large language models (LLMs) reproduce official crash coding. This study benchmarked six frontier LLMs by comparing narrative-derived crash attribute codes with corresponding fields in the Arkansas fatal-crash database. The analysis linked 5,587 fatal-crash narratives with 5,889 structured crash records from Arkansas (2015-2025), yielding 4,194 matched crashes. Six LLMs were evaluated using an identical zero-shot prompt to code crash manner, non-motorist relation, intersection type, work-zone relation, roadway surface condition, and light condition. Performance was evaluated using agreement, macro-averaged F1 score, Cohen's kappa, coverage, selective agreement, and comparisons with always-majority, always-Unknown, and keyword-rule baselines. Repeated-measures analyses and a generalized estimating equations model assessed differences among models and attributes. GPT-5.5 High achieved the highest agreement among the evaluated LLMs, but the always-majority baseline produced higher raw agreement and the keyword-rule baseline achieved macro-averaged F1 score and Cohen's kappa comparable to the best-performing LLM. Agreement was highest for non-motorist relation and crash manner and lowest for light condition, roadway surface condition, and work-zone relation. Differences across crash attributes exceeded differences across models. These results provide a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based crash coding and show that deployment should be evaluated on an attribute-specific basis using transparent baselines and human review.
2607.29064.paper_summary_zh: 警方事故敘述包含可能補充結構化事故數據庫的信息，但手動審查勞動密集，並且尚不清楚大型語言模型（LLMs）在多大程度上能重現官方事故編碼。本研究通過比較敘述衍生的事故屬性代碼與阿肯色州致命事故數據庫中的相應字段，對六個前沿LLM進行了基準測試。分析將5,587個致命事故敘述與來自阿肯色州（2015-2025）的5,889個結構化事故記錄聯繫起來，產生了4,194個匹配的事故。使用相同的零-shot提示對六個LLM進行了評估，以編碼事故方式、非駕駛者關係、交叉口類型、施工區域關係、道路表面條件和光照條件。性能評估使用了一致性、宏平均F1分數、Cohen's kappa、覆蓋率、選擇性一致性，並與始終多數、始終未知和關鍵詞規則基準進行比較。重複測量分析和廣義估計方程模型評估了模型和屬性之間的差異。GPT-5.5 High在評估的LLM中達成了最高的一致性，但始終多數基準產生了更高的原始一致性，而關鍵詞規則基準達到了與表現最佳的LLM相當的宏平均F1分數和Cohen's kappa。非駕駛者關係和事故方式的一致性最高，而光照條件、道路表面條件和施工區域關係的一致性最低。事故屬性之間的差異超過了模型之間的差異。這些結果為評估基於LLM的事故編碼提供了基準，並顯示部署應基於屬性特定的基礎進行評估，使用透明的基準和人工審查。
